question: Odacchi! In Volume 70, Chapter 700, Sanji made onigiri for Law, who doesn't like bread. What was inside those onigiri?
answer: Well, the first onigiri had Tuna-mayonnaise inside. The second onigiri had okaka inside. And the last onigiri had super sour umeboshi inside. By the way, Law hates umeboshi. A few minutes later, he and Sanji got into an argument because of that.
name: Natsuki
